description: Erection of a side roof extension to form a hip to gable roof, including demolition of an existing chimney stack, installation of 2no. rooflights in the front roofslope, and 1no. rooflight in the side roofslope; erection of a rear dormer roof extension, following the removal of existing dormer window in the rear roofslope; erection of a part two, part single storey rear extension single storey rear extension, following the demolition of existing ground floor back addition; installation of an air conditioning condenser unit within an acoustic enclosure, to the side elevation at ground floor level. (Ground floor rear extension approved under planning permission ref: 2023/02610/FUL, first floor rear extension approved under planning permission ref: 2025/01053/FUL, and works to roof level approved under planning permission ref: 2024/00969/FUL).
borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
